newsitem.title: USA: ProSource Q1 oper shr runs profit.
newsitem.headline: ProSource Q1 oper shr runs profit.

text.p: (in millions, except share and per share data)
Loss on impairment of long-lived assets -- 15.7
NOTE: (/a) The 1996 loss before special and unusual charges relating to impairment losses and restructuring charges was $2.5 million or $0.48 per share.

Earnings before extraordinary items totaled $0.3 million or $.03 per share versus a loss of $19.2 million or $3.64 per share in the same period last year. The net loss for the year-earlier period reflected restructuring charges of $10.9 million and impairment losses of $15.7 million, or a total of $16.7 million or $3.16 per share on an after-tax basis. The 1996 first quarter net loss before these special and unusual charges totaled $2.5 million or $0.48 per share.

In connection with the early extinguishment of a previous credit facility, the company incurred an after-tax extraordinary charge of $6.3 million or $0.67 per share reflecting prepayment penalties, the write-off of deferred financing costs, and the cancellation of interest rate protection agreements. The company's net loss for the first quarter of 1997 after this extraordinary charge was $6.0 million or $.64 per share.
